turns.content: Good to hear from you. What's been going on?
i don't really know why i'm texting. i just opened this thread and i'm here.
That's enough of a reason. What's the loudest thing right now?
do you remember the project i was working on. the one i kept stalling on.
I don't retain memory between conversations, so I'm coming in fresh. But I'm here now — tell me about it. The one you kept stalling on.
i finished it. i don't know if it's good. i'm not sending it to you yet. i just wanted to say it.

You finished it. That's real. 

How does it feel to have said that out loud?
